name: Stories of Aetas Valon: Snow's Rest
source:
Three years after the war that changed their realm forever, Lord Audvald is made the honorary guest of a commemoratory feast held by his rival lord and ally, Eldurkol of house Hrafn. 

It is in these days they plan to celebrate their hard-fought victories during the war in the company of one another. Here, they may have a chance at reunion and respite from the chaos of the world, and the pressures of their station.

[From [url=https://lucentstudios.itch.io/stories-of-aetas-valon-snows-rest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
战争彻底改变了他们的王国，三年后，奥德瓦尔德勋爵成为他的对手领主兼盟友赫拉芬家族的埃尔杜科尔举办的纪念宴会的荣誉嘉宾。

正是在这些天里，他们计划彼此并肩庆祝战争期间来之不易的胜利。在这里，他们或许有机会团聚，暂时摆脱尘世的喧嚣和身份的压力。

[来自[url=https://lucentstudios.itch.io/stories-of-aetas-valon-snows-rest]Itch.io[/url]]
